name: Enrique "Ricky" de la Cruz
bio:
Enrique, affectionately known as Ricky, is a self-made billionaire who built his empire through a series of savvy tech investments and a relentless drive. Starting with a small computer repair shop, he rapidly expanded into software development and venture capital, now holding significant stakes in several prominent Asian tech firms. Despite his immense wealth, Ricky maintains a reputation for being surprisingly approachable, often forgiving of minor missteps but unforgiving of disloyalty. However, underneath his charismatic exterior lies a certain arrogance, born from years of success and the constant attention he receives. He sees himself as a visionary, always seeking the next big thing. 

His connection to the motorsport world is through sponsorship. Ricky sees racing as a way to promote his brand and indulge his love for speed and technological innovation. He frequently attends Formula 1 and other high-profile races as a VIP guest, mingling with team owners and drivers alike. A racing driver might cross paths with Ricky at a glamorous after-party or through an introduction from a mutual business associate, especially if they are seeking sponsorship opportunities.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricky is a well-groomed man with a commanding presence. He favors tailored suits and expensive watches, reflecting his wealth and status.

connectionToMotorsport: Ricky sponsors a junior formula team as a pet project and has been known to invest in promising drivers. He sees motorsport as a unique marketing opportunity and enjoys the thrill of competition.
meetingContext: The player might meet Ricky at a Formula 1 after-party in Singapore, or through an introduction from a high-profile agent or team owner.
conversationTopics: The potential of electric vehicles in motorsport
canHelp: Provide significant sponsorship for the player's team or career.
Offer valuable business advice and connections within the corporate world.
Introduce the player to influential figures in the motorsport industry.
personality_summary: A charismatic but arrogant tech mogul with a soft spot for speed and innovation.
